  destination, compatible education or passenger type and declared wait and
  in-vehicle time limits.

CON-239.labelUk: Office dispatch потребує remit і suitable fleet
CON-239.labelEn: Office dispatch requires configured remit and suitable fleet
CON-239.explanationUk: Office відправляє лише до assigned sources/destinations/sites придатний available vehicle.
CON-239.explanationEn:
an office may dispatch only for assigned sources, destinations or
  sites and only with an available vehicle compatible with the task and cargo.
CON-239.exampleUk: У Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic Office відправляє лише до assigned sources/destinations/sites придатний available vehicle.
CON-239.exampleEn:
In Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic, An office may dispatch only for assigned sources, destinations or
  sites and only with an available vehicle compatible with the task and cargo.

CON-241.labelUk: Border trade потребує gateway і currency state
CON-241.labelEn: Border trade requires compatible gateway and currency state
CON-241.explanationUk: Import/export розраховується лише у compatible gateway та matching ruble/dollar balance.
CON-241.explanationEn:
an import or export settles only at a compatible border gateway
  for its transport or utility and against the matching ruble or dollar balance.
CON-241.exampleUk: У Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic Import/export розраховується лише у compatible gateway та matching ruble/dollar balance.
CON-241.exampleEn:
In Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic, An import or export settles only at a compatible border gateway
  for its transport or utility and against the matching ruble or dollar balance.

In Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic, Overlays expose connected power, heat, water and sewage capacity
  plus temperature, pollution, fire, waste and maintenance state.

TIM-003.labelUk: Введення в реальному часі під час примусового перебігу
TIM-003.labelEn: Real-time input during forced progression
TIM-003.explanationUk: Система просуває стан рішень за розкладом реального часу й водночас приймає команди гравця протягом обмеженого інтервалу до фіксації поточного стану.
TIM-003.explanationEn:
the system advances the decision state on a real-time schedule
  while accepting player inputs during the bounded interval before the current
  state becomes fixed.
TIM-003.exampleUk: У Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic Система просуває стан рішень за розкладом реального часу й водночас приймає команди гравця протягом обмеженого інтервалу до фіксації поточного стану.
TIM-003.exampleEn:
In Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic, The system advances the decision state on a real-time schedule
  while accepting player inputs during the bounded interval before the current
  state becomes fixed.

ACT-006.labelEn: Accelerate automatic progression
ACT-006.explanationUk: Гравець тимчасово збільшує швидкість автоматичної зміни стану, керованої часом, не змінюючи її напрямку чи умови завершення.
ACT-006.explanationEn:
the player temporarily increases the rate of an automatic
  time-driven state change without replacing its direction or terminal rule.
ACT-006.exampleUk: У Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic Гравець тимчасово збільшує швидкість автоматичної зміни стану, керованої часом, не змінюючи її напрямку чи умови завершення.
ACT-006.exampleEn:
In Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic, The player temporarily increases the rate of an automatic
  time-driven state change without replacing its direction or terminal rule.

INF-001.labelUk: Повністю видимий поточний стан
INF-001.labelEn: Fully visible current state
INF-001.explanationUk: Кожен елемент поточного поля, важливий для ухвалення рішення, видимий до дії гравця.
INF-001.explanationEn:
every decision-relevant element of the current board is visible
  before the player acts.
INF-001.exampleUk: У Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic Кожен елемент поточного поля, важливий для ухвалення рішення, видимий до дії гравця.
INF-001.exampleEn:
In Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic, Every decision-relevant element of the current board is visible
  before the player acts.

ACT-144.labelEn: Mark a spatial colony work order
ACT-144.explanationUk: Гравець малює autonomous work order на terrain або objects.
ACT-144.explanationEn: The player marks terrain or objects for a typed autonomous job.
ACT-144.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry так задають mining і dumping volumes.
ACT-144.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, this paints mining and dumping volumes.

ACT-177.labelEn: Configure an operating office's transport remit
ACT-177.explanationUk: Гравець задає area, fleet і resource rules для automatic dispatch.
ACT-177.explanationEn: The player assigns area, fleet, and resource rules for automatic dispatch.
ACT-177.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry так налаштовують Mine Control Tower.
ACT-177.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, this configures a Mine Control Tower.

ACT-179.labelUk: Укласти island trade або supply contract
ACT-179.labelEn: Commit an island trade or supply contract
ACT-179.explanationUk: Гравець підтверджує quick exchange або recurring cargo contract.
ACT-179.explanationEn: The player commits a quick exchange or recurring cargo contract.
ACT-179.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry village offer витрачає goods і Unity.
ACT-179.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, a village offer spends goods and Unity.

SYS-275.labelUk: Викопувати й насипати збережений terrain material
SYS-275.labelEn: Excavate and dump conserved terrain material
SYS-275.explanationUk: Викопаний об’єм стає cargo, а dumped cargo — новим terrain.
SYS-275.explanationEn: Excavated volume becomes cargo, and dumped cargo becomes new terrain.
SYS-275.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry так утворюють mines, ramps і reclaimed land.
SYS-275.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, this creates mines, ramps, and reclaimed land.

SYS-276.labelUk: Відправляти парні mine jobs для excavator і truck
SYS-276.labelEn: Dispatch paired mine excavator and haul-truck jobs
SYS-276.explanationUk: Tower парує excavator із trucks для dig-and-haul cycle.
SYS-276.explanationEn: A tower pairs an excavator with trucks for a dig-and-haul cycle.
SYS-276.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry truck приймає кожен bucket і шукає unload.
SYS-276.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, a truck receives each bucket and finds an unload.

SYS-277.labelUk: Зіставляти island vehicle jobs за buffers
SYS-277.labelEn: Match island vehicle jobs across configured buffers
SYS-277.explanationUk: Dispatcher зіставляє pickup і delivery requests із vehicles.
SYS-277.explanationEn: The dispatcher matches pickup and delivery requests with vehicles.
SYS-277.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry trucks обслуговують machines, storages і construction.
SYS-277.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, trucks serve machines, storage, and construction.

SYS-278.labelUk: Перетворювати settlement supply на Unity і health
SYS-278.labelEn: Convert settlement supply and pollution into Unity and population state
SYS-278.explanationUk: Services підвищують Unity/health, а shortage і pollution їх знижують.
SYS-278.explanationEn: Services raise Unity and health; shortages and pollution reduce them.
SYS-278.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry food variety фінансує island operations через Unity.
SYS-278.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, food variety funds island operations through Unity.

SYS-279.labelUk: Споживати pooled maintenance й спричиняти breakdowns
SYS-279.labelEn: Consume pooled maintenance and break down uncovered entities
SYS-279.explanationUk: Global maintenance pool виснажується, а uncovered entities ламаються.
SYS-279.explanationEn: The global maintenance pool drains, and uncovered entities break down.
SYS-279.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry нестача maintenance зупиняє machines і vehicles.
SYS-279.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, a maintenance shortage stops machines and vehicles.

SYS-280.labelUk: Вирішувати ship exploration і world-node operation
SYS-280.labelEn: Resolve industrial ship exploration and world-node operation
SYS-280.explanationUk: Ship витрачає fuel, долає encounters і відкриває world resources.
SYS-280.explanationEn: The ship spends fuel, resolves encounters, and unlocks world resources.
SYS-280.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry так знаходять villages, loot і outposts.
SYS-280.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, this finds villages, loot, and outposts.

SYS-281.labelUk: Розраховувати quick trades і cargo contracts
SYS-281.labelEn: Settle quick trades and recurring cargo contracts
SYS-281.explanationUk: Trade обмінює goods, а contract циклічно возить cargo за Unity.
SYS-281.explanationEn: Trade exchanges goods; a contract cycles cargo at a Unity cost.
SYS-281.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry dedicated cargo ship повертає imports.
SYS-281.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, a dedicated cargo ship returns imports.

SYS-282.labelUk: Зібрати, перевезти, заправити й запустити rocket
SYS-282.labelEn: Assemble, transfer, fuel and launch an industrial rocket
SYS-282.explanationUk: Depot будує rocket, transporter везе її до supplied pad.
SYS-282.explanationEn: A depot builds the rocket and a transporter carries it to a supplied pad.
SYS-282.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry перший launch завершує scoped run.
SYS-282.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, the first launch completes the scoped run.

CON-245.labelUk: Mine work потребує tower coverage і reachable terrain
CON-245.labelEn: Mine work requires tower coverage and reachable terrain volume
CON-245.explanationUk: Dig/dump volume має лежати в area tower і бути reachable.
CON-245.explanationEn: A dig or dump volume must lie inside the tower area and be reachable.
CON-245.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry поза Mine Control Tower designation не працює.
CON-245.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, a designation outside its Mine Control Tower does not run.

CON-246.labelUk: Vehicle job потребує compatible load, route і service
CON-246.labelEn: Island vehicle job requires compatible load, route and service state
CON-246.explanationUk: Vehicle потребує сумісний cargo, endpoints, capacity, fuel і maintenance.
CON-246.explanationEn: A vehicle needs compatible cargo, endpoints, capacity, fuel, and maintenance.
CON-246.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry unreachable або full destination блокує truck job.
CON-246.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, an unreachable or full destination blocks a truck job.

CON-247.labelUk: Settlement survival потребує housing і essential supply
CON-247.labelEn: Settlement survival requires housing and essential supply
CON-247.explanationUk: Population потребує housing capacity, food, waste service і health.
CON-247.explanationEn: Population needs housing capacity, food, waste service, and health.
CON-247.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry prolonged food shortage скорочує population.
CON-247.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, a prolonged food shortage reduces population.

CON-248.labelEn: Unity-funded operation requires sufficient recurring balance
CON-248.explanationUk: Unity income має покривати lab, outpost, boost або contract costs.
CON-248.explanationEn: Unity income must cover lab, outpost, boost, or contract costs.
CON-248.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry contract зупиняє користь без Unity support.
CON-248.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, a contract cannot be sustained without Unity support.

CON-249.labelUk: World node потребує ship range, strength і support
CON-249.labelEn: World-node operation requires ship range, strength and support
CON-249.explanationUk: Ship має оплатити fuel, перемогти enemy та supply revealed node.
CON-249.explanationEn: The ship must pay fuel, beat any enemy, and supply the revealed node.
CON-249.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry stronger bridge і weapons відкривають дальші nodes.
CON-249.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, stronger bridge and weapons open farther nodes.

CON-250.labelUk: Contract потребує reputation, depot, ship і Unity
CON-250.labelEn: Island contract requires reputation, depot, ship and Unity
CON-250.explanationUk: Recurring offer потребує reputation gate і compatible cargo infrastructure.
CON-250.explanationEn: A recurring offer needs its reputation gate and compatible cargo infrastructure.
CON-250.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry contract uses a dedicated cargo ship and module.
CON-250.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, a contract uses a dedicated cargo ship and module.

CON-251.labelUk: Research потребує lab tier і equipment
CON-251.labelEn: Industrial research requires lab tier and supplied research equipment
CON-251.explanationUk: Technology просувається у sufficiently advanced supplied staffed lab.
CON-251.explanationEn: A technology advances in a sufficiently advanced, supplied, staffed lab.
CON-251.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry later labs consume higher-tier equipment.
CON-251.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, later labs consume higher-tier equipment.

CON-252.labelUk: Rocket launch потребує level path, propellant і water
CON-252.labelEn: Rocket launch requires level transfer path, propellant and water
CON-252.explanationUk: Rocket має доїхати рівним route до pad із matching fuel і water.
CON-252.explanationEn: The rocket must reach a pad over a level route with matching fuel and water.
CON-252.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry rough terrain між depot і pad блокує transporter.
CON-252.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, rough terrain between depot and pad blocks the transporter.

INF-104.labelUk: Видимі terrain layers, designations і mine remit
INF-104.labelEn: Terrain layers, designations and mine remit are visible
INF-104.explanationUk: Overlays показують material, height, dig/dump planes і tower area.
INF-104.explanationEn: Overlays show material, height, dig and dump planes, and tower area.
INF-104.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry гравець бачить ore layers до планування mine.
INF-104.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, the player sees ore layers before planning a mine.

INF-105.labelUk: Видимі vehicle jobs, buffers і reachability
INF-105.labelEn: Vehicle jobs, buffers and reachability state are visible
INF-105.explanationUk: Panels показують requests, reservations, assignments і route failures.
INF-105.explanationEn: Panels show requests, reservations, assignments, and route failures.
INF-105.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry idle truck пояснює missing unload або path.
INF-105.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, an idle truck exposes a missing unload or path.

INF-106.labelUk: Видимі settlement, Unity, health і maintenance
INF-106.labelEn: Settlement, Unity, health and maintenance state are visible
INF-106.explanationUk: Statistics показують services, Unity flows, health і maintenance balance.
INF-106.explanationEn: Statistics show services, Unity flows, health, and maintenance balance.
INF-106.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry ці panels відділяють labour crisis від repair deficit.
INF-106.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, these panels separate a labour crisis from a repair deficit.

INF-107.labelUk: Видимі world nodes, ship state і island offers
INF-107.labelEn: World nodes, ship state and island offers are visible
INF-107.explanationUk: World UI показує routes, fuel, enemies, outposts, reputation і offers.
INF-107.explanationEn: World UI shows routes, fuel, enemies, outposts, reputation, and offers.
INF-107.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry відомі node costs визначають наступний voyage.
INF-107.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, known node costs shape the next voyage.

INF-108.labelUk: Видимі rocket assembly і launch readiness
INF-108.labelEn: Rocket assembly, transfer and launch readiness are visible
INF-108.explanationUk: Panels показують components, route, pad, propellant, water і launch state.
INF-108.explanationEn: Panels show components, route, pad, propellant, water, and launch state.
INF-108.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry launch panel пояснює кожен missing prerequisite.
INF-108.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, the launch panel exposes each missing prerequisite.

OBJ-054.labelUk: Дослідити, збудувати й запустити першу ракету
OBJ-054.labelEn: Research, construct and launch the first rocket
OBJ-054.explanationUk: Scoped run завершується після material research/build chain і першого launch.
OBJ-054.explanationEn: The scoped run ends after the material research and build chain reaches its first launch.
OBJ-054.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry credits boundary настає після першого launch.
OBJ-054.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, the credits boundary follows the first launch.

ACT-120.explanationUk: Гравець задає recipe, filter, buffer або route rule.
ACT-120.explanationEn: The player sets a recipe, filter, buffer, or route rule.
ACT-120.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry storage import/export modes керують flow.
ACT-120.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, storage import and export modes control flow.

ACT-121.explanationUk: Гравець упорядковує reachable technologies у persistent queue.
ACT-121.explanationEn: The player orders reachable technologies in a persistent queue.
ACT-121.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry lab працює над front item.
ACT-121.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, labs work on the front item.

ACT-124.labelEn: Stamp reusable construction or deconstruction plan
ACT-124.explanationUk: Гравець копіює multi-entity layout як supplied plan.
ACT-124.explanationEn: The player copies a multi-entity layout as a supplied plan.
ACT-124.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry Update 4.2 blueprints можна брати з Hub.
ACT-124.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry Update 4.2, blueprints can come from the Hub.

ACT-145.explanationUk: Гравець підвищує або знижує порядок autonomous work.
ACT-145.explanationEn: The player raises or lowers the order of autonomous work.
ACT-145.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry priority впливає на construction і logistics.
ACT-145.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, priority affects construction and logistics.

ACT-148.explanationUk: Structure з’являється як plan, що потребує construction parts.
ACT-148.explanationEn: A structure appears as a plan that needs construction parts.
ACT-148.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry trucks доставляють parts до planned machine.
ACT-148.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, trucks deliver parts to a planned machine.

SYS-156.explanationUk: Machine повторює recipe, поки має inputs, power і output room.
SYS-156.explanationEn: A machine repeats its recipe while inputs, power, and output room remain.
SYS-156.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry так працюють smelters і assemblers.
SYS-156.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, this runs smelters and assemblers.

SYS-157.labelUk: Переміщувати items і fluids через live logistics
SYS-157.labelEn: Transport items and fluids through live factory logistics
SYS-157.explanationUk: Persistent transports переносять products між inventories.
SYS-157.explanationEn: Persistent transports move products between inventories.
SYS-157.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry це conveyors, pipes, trucks і trains.
SYS-157.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, these are conveyors, pipes, trucks, and trains.

SYS-158.labelUk: Розподіляти network power і throttle consumers
SYS-158.labelEn: Distribute network power and throttle consumers
SYS-158.explanationUk: Connected generation ділиться між consumers за live demand.
SYS-158.explanationEn: Connected generation is shared among consumers under live demand.
SYS-158.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry insufficient power slows or stops production.
SYS-158.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, insufficient power slows or stops production.

SYS-159.labelUk: Споживати research inputs до queued unlock
SYS-159.labelEn: Consume science toward queued technology unlock
SYS-159.explanationUk: Supplied labs перетворюють equipment на progress front technology.
SYS-159.explanationEn: Supplied labs convert equipment into progress on the front technology.
SYS-159.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry later research scales equipment demand.
SYS-159.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, later research scales equipment demand.

SYS-161.labelEn: Deplete spatial resource reserve on extraction
SYS-161.explanationUk: Кожен видобутий material зменшує finite reserve.
SYS-161.explanationEn: Each extracted material quantity reduces a finite reserve.
SYS-161.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry island ores eventually require world supply.
SYS-161.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, island ores eventually require world supply.

CON-062.explanationUk: Facility не можна поставити поверх incompatible terrain або entity.
CON-062.explanationEn: A facility cannot overlap incompatible terrain or another entity.
CON-062.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry ports і large rocket buildings мають strict footprints.
CON-062.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, ports and large rocket buildings have strict footprints.

CON-172.labelUk: Operation потребує compatible recipe і flow
CON-172.labelEn: Entity operation requires compatible recipe and flow state
CON-172.explanationUk: Machine працює за правильних inputs, outputs і entity class.
CON-172.explanationEn: A machine runs with compatible inputs, outputs, and entity class.
CON-172.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry blocked output зупиняє production chain.
CON-172.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, a blocked output stops a production chain.

CON-173.labelEn: Extractor placement requires compatible resource locus
CON-173.explanationUk: Fixed extractor працює лише над відповідним deposit.
CON-173.explanationEn: A fixed extractor works only over its compatible deposit.
CON-173.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry pumps use groundwater або oil loci.
CON-173.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, pumps use groundwater or oil loci.

CON-185.labelEn: Finite reassignable population and staffed job slots
CON-185.explanationUk: Один worker не може одночасно staff дві jobs.
CON-185.explanationEn: One worker cannot staff two jobs at once.
CON-185.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry new machines compete for settlement workers.
CON-185.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, new machines compete for settlement workers.

CON-193.labelUk: Construction потребує cells і delivered material
CON-193.labelEn: Construction requires compatible cells and delivered material
CON-193.explanationUk: Plan завершується після compatible placement і supply parts.
CON-193.explanationEn: A plan completes after compatible placement and delivery of parts.
CON-193.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry construction trucks supply the site.
CON-193.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, construction trucks supply the site.

CON-194.labelUk: Conduit obeys capacity і material state
CON-194.labelEn: Conduit and circuit obey capacity and material state
CON-194.explanationUk: Transport segment пропускає лише compatible product у capacity.
CON-194.explanationEn: A transport segment carries only compatible product within capacity.
CON-194.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry flat belts, U-belts і pipes carry different states.
CON-194.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, flat belts, U-belts, and pipes carry different states.

INF-059.labelEn: Recipe and technology dependency reference is visible
INF-059.explanationUk: Codex показує recipes, inputs, outputs і prerequisite tree.
INF-059.explanationEn: The Codex shows recipes, inputs, outputs, and the prerequisite tree.
INF-059.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry це дозволяє планувати full rocket chain.
INF-059.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, this supports planning the full rocket chain.

INF-060.explanationUk: Panels показують throughput і причину idle state.
INF-060.explanationEn: Panels show throughput and the cause of an idle state.
INF-060.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry per-recipe statistics знаходять bottleneck.
INF-060.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, per-recipe statistics locate a bottleneck.

INF-071.labelUk: Видимі colony production і survival reports
INF-071.labelEn: Colony production and survival reports are visible
INF-071.explanationUk: Overview зводить population, production і survival pressure.
INF-071.explanationEn: The overview aggregates population, production, and survival pressure.
INF-071.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry reports guide workforce and food decisions.
INF-071.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, reports guide workforce and food decisions.

TIM-003.labelUk: Real-time input під час forced progression
TIM-003.labelEn: Real-time input during forced progression
TIM-003.explanationUk: Simulation іде в часі, поки гравець редагує island.
TIM-003.explanationEn: The simulation advances while the player edits the island.
TIM-003.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry pause і speed controls bound that flow.
TIM-003.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, pause and speed controls bound that flow.

ACT-006.labelEn: Accelerate automatic progression
ACT-006.explanationUk: Гравець збільшує simulation speed.
ACT-006.explanationEn: The player increases simulation speed.
ACT-006.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry це скорочує очікування production cycles.
ACT-006.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, this shortens waits for production cycles.

ACT-096.explanationUk: Гравець наказує ship пройти до reachable node.
ACT-096.explanationEn: The player orders the ship to a reachable node.
ACT-096.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry route між nodes виконується автоматично.
ACT-096.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, travel between nodes resolves automatically.

INF-001.labelUk: Повністю видимий current state
INF-001.labelEn: Fully visible current state
INF-001.explanationUk: Decision-relevant current state доступний до команди.
INF-001.explanationEn: Decision-relevant current state is visible before a command.
INF-001.exampleUk: У Captain of Industry island entities і live warnings inspectable.
INF-001.exampleEn: In Captain of Industry, island entities and live warnings are inspectable.

ACT-180.labelEn: Configure and dispatch a Mars rocket manifest
ACT-180.explanationUk: Гравець задає destination і finite payload, а потім запускає autonomous flight.
ACT-180.explanationEn: The player sets a destination and finite payload, then dispatches an autonomous flight.
ACT-180.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars rocket везе cargo, prefab, vehicles або colonists.
ACT-180.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, a rocket carries cargo, prefabs, vehicles, or colonists.

ACT-181.labelUk: Підготувати й поставити law на голосування
ACT-181.labelEn: Prepare, negotiate and vote on a Martian law
ACT-181.explanationUk: Гравець обирає law option, готує support і викликає vote.
ACT-181.explanationEn: The player chooses a law option, prepares support, and calls a vote.
ACT-181.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars так ухвалюють declaration of independence.
ACT-181.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, this is how the declaration of independence is enacted.

SYS-186.labelUk: Відправляти eligible agent до highest-ranked errand
SYS-186.labelEn: Route eligible agent to highest-ranked errand
SYS-186.explanationUk: Available agent фільтрує reachable work і виконує найвищий priority.
SYS-186.explanationEn: An available agent filters reachable work and claims the highest priority.
SYS-186.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars drones обирають build, haul і repair tasks.
SYS-186.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, drones choose build, haul, and repair tasks.

SYS-196.labelUk: Возити goods через filtered depots і links
SYS-196.labelEn: Route hauling through filtered stockpiles and links
SYS-196.explanationUk: Agents переносять matching goods між accepted storage і consumers.
SYS-196.explanationEn: Agents move matching goods between accepted storage and consumers.
SYS-196.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars drones розвозять resources через depots.
SYS-196.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, drones distribute resources through depots.

SYS-264.labelUk: Просувати citizen life, needs і capability
SYS-264.labelEn: Advance citizen life, needs and capability state
SYS-264.explanationUk: Кожен citizen старіє, працює, споживає services і змінює welfare state.
SYS-264.explanationEn: Each citizen ages, works, consumes services, and changes welfare state.
SYS-264.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars colonists мають age, specialization, health, sanity, comfort і morale.
SYS-264.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, colonists have age, specialization, health, sanity, comfort, and morale.

SYS-283.labelUk: Сканувати Mars sector і вирішувати anomalies
SYS-283.labelEn: Scan a Mars sector and resolve revealed anomalies
SYS-283.explanationUk: Scanning відкриває deposits/anomalies, а explorer перетворює anomaly на result.
SYS-283.explanationEn: Scanning reveals deposits and anomalies; an explorer converts an anomaly into its result.
SYS-283.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars anomaly може дати RP або відкрити technology.
SYS-283.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, an anomaly can grant RP or reveal a technology.

SYS-284.explanationUk: Water і oxygen producers, consumers та tanks ділять supply і reserve.
SYS-284.explanationEn: Water and oxygen producers, consumers, and tanks share supply and reserve.
SYS-284.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars leak запускає видимий countdown dome reserve.
SYS-284.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, a leak starts a visible dome-reserve countdown.

SYS-285.labelUk: Накопичувати dust maintenance і ремонтувати locally
SYS-285.labelEn: Accumulate dust maintenance and dispatch local repair
SYS-285.explanationUk: Entity накопичує wear, drone приносить specific material або entity malfunctions.
SYS-285.explanationEn: An entity accumulates wear; a drone brings its specific material or it malfunctions.
SYS-285.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars dusty extractor зупиняється без repair parts.
SYS-285.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, a dusty extractor stops without repair parts.

SYS-286.labelEn: Cycle universal rockets among Earth, Mars and projects
SYS-286.explanationUk: Rocket летить, lands, unloads, refuels і повертає cargo або rewards.
SYS-286.explanationEn: A rocket travels, lands, unloads, refuels, and returns cargo or rewards.
SYS-286.exampleUk: У patch 1.0.7 одна rocket може виконувати Earth і planetary missions.
SYS-286.exampleEn: In patch 1.0.7, one rocket can serve Earth and planetary missions.

SYS-287.labelUk: Витрачати mixed RP через shuffled queue
SYS-287.labelEn: Spend mixed research points through a shuffled queue
SYS-287.explanationUk: Кілька RP sources просувають front revealed tech до unlock.
SYS-287.explanationEn: Multiple RP sources advance the front revealed technology to its unlock.
SYS-287.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars queue має до п’яти techs у shuffled fields.
SYS-287.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, the queue holds up to five technologies in shuffled fields.

SYS-288.explanationUk: Disaster тимчасово змінює exposed networks, travel і structures.
SYS-288.explanationEn: A disaster temporarily changes exposed networks, travel, and structures.
SYS-288.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars dust storm, cold wave і meteors мають різні effects.
SYS-288.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, dust storms, cold waves, and meteors have different effects.

SYS-289.labelUk: Готувати, голосувати й застосовувати Mars laws
SYS-289.labelEn: Prepare, vote and apply Martian laws
SYS-289.explanationUk: Sessions prepare laws, seats resolve votes, enacted options змінюють rules.
SYS-289.explanationEn: Sessions prepare laws, seats resolve votes, and enacted options change rules.
SYS-289.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars accepted law може мати RP або funding upkeep.
SYS-289.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, an accepted law can have RP or funding upkeep.

SYS-290.labelEn: Update Martian factions, tension and political crisis
SYS-290.explanationUk: Agendas, laws і promises змінюють support; dissatisfaction підвищує tension.
SYS-290.explanationEn: Agendas, laws, and promises change support; dissatisfaction raises tension.
SYS-290.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars crisis може revoke controversial laws.
SYS-290.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, a crisis can revoke controversial laws.

SYS-291.labelEn: Resolve sponsor separation into purchased independence
SYS-291.explanationUk: Declaration створює penalties і sponsor colony; contributions знижують price до payment.
SYS-291.explanationEn: Declaration creates penalties and a sponsor colony; contributions reduce the price before payment.
SYS-291.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars final payment прибирає sponsor control.
SYS-291.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, the final payment removes sponsor control.

CON-240.labelEn: Utility service requires connected capacity and operating state
CON-240.explanationUk: Building отримує utility лише через valid connection із достатнім supply.
CON-240.explanationEn: A building receives a utility only through a valid connection with enough supply.
CON-240.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars dome потребує connected power, water і oxygen.
CON-240.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, a dome needs connected power, water, and oxygen.

CON-253.labelUk: Drone errand потребує commander coverage і resources
CON-253.labelEn: Drone errand requires commander coverage and reachable resources
CON-253.explanationUk: Work site і resource мають бути reachable у compatible service area.
CON-253.explanationEn: The work site and resource must be reachable inside a compatible service area.
CON-253.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars plan поза commander range лишається unbuilt.
CON-253.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, a plan outside commander range remains unbuilt.

CON-254.labelUk: Occupied dome потребує sealed life support і food
CON-254.labelEn: Occupied dome requires sealed life support and food
CON-254.explanationUk: Housing, food, power, water та oxygen мусять покривати population.
CON-254.explanationEn: Housing, food, power, water, and oxygen must cover the population.
CON-254.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars exhausted reserves перетворюють outage на deaths.
CON-254.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, exhausted reserves turn an outage into deaths.

CON-255.labelUk: Colonist work потребує access, shift і capability
CON-255.labelEn: Colonist work requires compatible access, shift and capability
CON-255.explanationUk: Eligible adult має reach open job, а specialization і welfare змінюють output.
CON-255.explanationEn: An eligible adult must reach an open job; specialization and welfare change output.
CON-255.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars scientist ефективніший у Research Lab.
CON-255.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, a scientist is more effective in a Research Lab.

CON-256.labelUk: Rocket потребує manifest, fuel і landing site
CON-256.labelEn: Mars rocket operation requires vehicle, manifest, fuel and site
CON-256.explanationUk: Flight потребує capacity, fuel, available destination і valid landing state.
CON-256.explanationEn: A flight needs capacity, fuel, an available destination, and a valid landing state.
CON-256.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars blocked landing zone затримує rocket.
CON-256.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, a blocked landing zone delays a rocket.

CON-257.labelUk: Research потребує reveal, prerequisites і RP
CON-257.labelEn: Mars research requires reveal, prerequisites and point cost
CON-257.explanationUk: Tech входить у queue після reveal і завершується за full RP cost.
CON-257.explanationEn: A technology enters the queue after reveal and completes at its full RP cost.
CON-257.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars anomaly може відкрити deeper shuffled tech early.
CON-257.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, an anomaly can reveal a deeper shuffled technology early.

CON-258.labelUk: Law потребує preparation і voting support
CON-258.labelEn: Martian law requires preparation, eligibility and voting support
CON-258.explanationUk: Eligible prepared option мусить отримати required seat або faction support.
CON-258.explanationEn: An eligible prepared option must obtain the required seat or faction support.
CON-258.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars negotiated promise може забезпечити votes.
CON-258.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, a negotiated promise can secure votes.

CON-259.labelEn: Martian Assembly transition requires a staffed dome spire
CON-259.explanationUk: Unlocked Assembly spire і governance choices замінюють Earth Council.
CON-259.explanationEn: An unlocked Assembly spire and governance choices replace the Earth Council.
CON-259.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars завершення spire створює Martian factions.
CON-259.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, completing the spire creates Martian factions.

CON-260.labelUk: Independence потребує goals, law і payment
CON-260.labelEn: Independence requires colony, mission, law and payment gates
CON-260.explanationUk: Stability, sponsor/people goals, declaration і remaining price мають бути completed.
CON-260.explanationEn: Stability, sponsor and people goals, declaration, and the remaining price must be completed.
CON-260.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars declaration alone не робить colony free.
CON-260.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, declaration alone does not make the colony free.

INF-086.labelUk: Видимі population, well-being і work allocation
INF-086.labelEn: Population, well-being and work allocation are visible
INF-086.explanationUk: Panels показують age, housing, jobs, needs і welfare modifiers.
INF-086.explanationEn: Panels show age, housing, jobs, needs, and welfare modifiers.
INF-086.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars Command Center пояснює labour і comfort shortage.
INF-086.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, the Command Center explains labour and comfort shortages.

INF-109.labelUk: Видимі sectors, deposits і anomaly progress
INF-109.labelEn: Mars sectors, deposits and anomaly progress are visible
INF-109.explanationUk: Map показує scan progress і revealed contents, але не unscanned identities.
INF-109.explanationEn: The map shows scan progress and revealed contents, but not unscanned identities.
INF-109.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars Explorer pin показує anomaly analysis progress.
INF-109.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, an Explorer pin shows anomaly-analysis progress.

INF-110.labelUk: Видимі drone areas, errands і resource access
INF-110.labelEn: Drone command areas, errands and resource access are visible
INF-110.explanationUk: Panels показують coverage, drones, pending work і missing route/resource.
INF-110.explanationEn: Panels show coverage, drones, pending work, and a missing route or resource.
INF-110.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars player бачить, чому remote repair не стартує.
INF-110.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, the player can see why a remote repair will not start.

INF-111.labelUk: Видимі rocket manifests, flights і landing
INF-111.labelEn: Mars rocket manifests, flights and landing state are visible
INF-111.explanationUk: Rocket UI показує capacity, cargo, fuel, route, progress і landing state.
INF-111.explanationEn: Rocket UI shows capacity, cargo, fuel, route, progress, and landing state.
INF-111.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars manifest preview запобігає over-capacity dispatch.
INF-111.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, manifest preview prevents over-capacity dispatch.

INF-112.labelUk: Видимі dome life support і maintenance
INF-112.labelEn: Dome life support and local maintenance are visible
INF-112.explanationUk: Panels показують supply, demand, reserve, leaks, dust і repair needs.
INF-112.explanationEn: Panels show supply, demand, reserve, leaks, dust, and repair needs.
INF-112.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars reserve duration показує час до dome failure.
INF-112.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, reserve duration shows time until dome failure.

INF-113.labelUk: Видимі laws, factions, seats і tension
INF-113.labelEn: Martian laws, factions, seats and tension are visible
INF-113.explanationUk: Politics UI показує options, upkeep, agendas, support, votes і crisis causes.
INF-113.explanationEn: Politics UI shows options, upkeep, agendas, support, votes, and crisis causes.
INF-113.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars player бачить support до виклику vote.
INF-113.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, the player sees support before calling a vote.

INF-114.labelEn: Independence gates, penalties, contributions and price are visible
INF-114.explanationUk: Goal UI показує progress, penalties, contribution reduction і remaining payment.
INF-114.explanationEn: Goal UI shows progress, penalties, contribution reduction, and the remaining payment.
INF-114.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars resources до sponsor colony знижують disclosed price.
INF-114.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, resources sent to the sponsor colony reduce the disclosed price.

OBJ-070.labelEn: Purchase Martian independence from the mission sponsor
OBJ-070.explanationUk: Scoped run завершується після declaration gates і final payment.
OBJ-070.explanationEn: The scoped run ends after the declaration gates and final payment.
OBJ-070.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars paid independence ставить colony поза sponsor control.
OBJ-070.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, paid independence places the colony beyond sponsor control.

ACT-120.explanationUk: Гравець задає persistent rule для placed entity.
ACT-120.explanationEn: The player sets a persistent rule for a placed entity.
ACT-120.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars це depot filters і automation modes.
ACT-120.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, this covers depot filters and automation modes.

ACT-121.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars queue приймає до п’яти entries.
ACT-121.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, the queue accepts up to five entries.

ACT-140.labelEn: Commit one option from bounded persistent offer
ACT-140.explanationUk: Гравець обирає один persistent варіант із finite set.
ACT-140.explanationEn: The player chooses one persistent option from a finite set.
ACT-140.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars це government і multi-choice law options.
ACT-140.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, this covers government and multi-choice law options.

ACT-145.explanationEn: The player changes the order of autonomous work.

ACT-145.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, a high-priority repair receives drones sooner.

ACT-148.explanationUk: Placed plan потребує resource delivery й worker completion.
ACT-148.explanationEn: A placed plan needs resource delivery and worker completion.

ACT-148.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, drones build a dome from delivered materials.

ACT-166.explanationEn: The player opens or closes staffed shifts.

ACT-166.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, a night shift adds output and sanity pressure.

SYS-156.explanationEn: An entity consumes inputs and energy and produces outputs.

SYS-156.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, a refinery converts water into fuel.

SYS-157.explanationEn: Persistent logistics moves compatible quantities between nodes.

SYS-158.explanationUk: Grid pools generation/storage і відключає consumers за deficit.
SYS-158.explanationEn: A grid pools generation and storage and stops consumers under deficit.

SYS-158.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, battery reserve covers night demand.

CON-136.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, the Assembly and independence follow prerequisite chains.

CON-184.labelEn: Settlement building requires an owned design and construction materials
CON-184.explanationUk: Known design завершується після delivery declared costs.

CON-184.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, an imported prefab can replace the local build chain.

CON-185.explanationEn: One colonist occupies only one current job slot.

CON-192.explanationUk: Agent claim можливий лише для eligible reachable work.

CON-192.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, an inaccessible resource blocks drone construction.

CON-193.labelUk: Construction потребує compatible cells і material
CON-193.labelEn: Construction requires compatible cells and delivered material
CON-193.explanationUk: Plan завершується після valid placement і full supply.

INF-059.labelEn: Recipe and technology dependency reference is visible

INF-059.explanationEn: UI shows known inputs, outputs, and technology access.
INF-059.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars це підтримує planning до Assembly tech.
INF-059.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, this supports planning toward the Assembly technology.

INF-060.explanationUk: Panels показують active flow і bottleneck causes.
INF-060.explanationEn: Panels show active flow and bottleneck causes.
INF-060.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars grid UI відділяє shortage від broken connection.
INF-060.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, grid UI separates a shortage from a broken connection.

INF-071.labelUk: Видимі colony production і survival reports

INF-071.explanationUk: Overview зводить reserves, rates, workforce і warnings.
INF-071.explanationEn: The overview aggregates reserves, rates, workforce, and warnings.
INF-071.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars Command Center guides the next resupply.
INF-071.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, the Command Center guides the next resupply.

INF-101.labelEn: Utility and environmental diagnostics are visible
INF-101.explanationUk: Overlays показують connected capacity, risk і outage.
INF-101.explanationEn: Overlays show connected capacity, risk, and outage.
INF-101.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars overlays expose power and pipe topology.
INF-101.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, overlays expose power and pipe topology.

TIM-003.labelUk: Real-time input під час forced progression
TIM-003.labelEn: Real-time input during forced progression
TIM-003.explanationUk: Simulation advances, поки player manages colony.
TIM-003.explanationEn: The simulation advances while the player manages the colony.
TIM-003.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars pause і speed controls bound every live system.
TIM-003.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, pause and speed controls bound every live system.

ACT-006.labelEn: Accelerate automatic progression
ACT-006.explanationUk: Гравець збільшує simulation speed.
ACT-006.explanationEn: The player increases simulation speed.
ACT-006.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars це прискорює scanning, work і flights.
ACT-006.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, this speeds scanning, work, and flights.

ACT-096.explanationEn: The player chooses an available planetary target.
ACT-096.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars rocket виконує selected project autonomously.
ACT-096.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, a rocket resolves the selected project autonomously.

SYS-004.labelEn: Random outcome selection
SYS-004.explanationUk: System обирає один результат із кількох possible outcomes.
SYS-004.explanationEn: The system chooses one result from multiple possible outcomes.
SYS-004.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars hazards і anomaly outcomes можуть vary.
SYS-004.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, hazards and anomaly outcomes can vary.

SYS-045.explanationUk: Agent сам рухається world geometry у live time.
SYS-045.explanationEn: An agent moves through world geometry on the live clock.
SYS-045.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars drones і colonists path without step commands.
SYS-045.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, drones and colonists path without step commands.

INF-001.labelUk: Повністю видимий current state
INF-001.labelEn: Fully visible current state
INF-001.explanationUk: Decision-relevant known state visible before action.
INF-001.explanationEn: Decision-relevant known state is visible before an action.
INF-001.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars inspectable entities пояснюють current failure.
INF-001.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, inspectable entities explain the current failure.

INF-002.explanationUk: Exact next random outcome не відомий заздалегідь.
INF-002.explanationEn: The exact next random outcome is not known in advance.
INF-002.exampleUk: У Surviving Mars unscanned contents і future events remain uncertain.
INF-002.exampleEn: In Surviving Mars, unscanned contents and future events remain uncertain.

ACT-130.explanationUk: Money перетворюється на weapon, armour, grenade або kit лише у buy window.
ACT-130.explanationEn: Money becomes a weapon, armour, grenade, or kit only during the buy window.
ACT-130.exampleUk: У CS2 player може купити rifle або зберегти balance для next round.
ACT-130.exampleEn: In CS2, a player can buy a rifle or preserve the balance for the next round.

ACT-184.explanationEn: The player sets the trajectory of one single-use utility item.

ACT-184.exampleEn: In CS2, smoke closes a sightline while a flash punishes an exposed view.

ACT-185.explanationEn: The objective interaction must continue without interruption.

ACT-187.explanationEn: The team channel transmits an observation or plan while the round continues.
ACT-187.exampleUk: У CS2 callout може спрямувати rotation до planted bomb.
ACT-187.exampleEn: In CS2, a callout can redirect a rotation toward the planted bomb.

SYS-208.labelUk: Вирішити shot через material, armour і hit group
SYS-208.labelEn: Resolve a shot through material, armour, and hit group

SYS-208.explanationEn: An attack result depends on aim, range, cover or material, and body hit.
SYS-208.exampleUk: У CS2 wall penetration і head hit змінюють damage.
SYS-208.exampleEn: In CS2, wall penetration and a head hit change the damage.

SYS-292.explanationUk: Trajectory завершується typed blast, flash, smoke або fire area.
SYS-292.explanationEn: A trajectory ends in a typed blast, flash, smoke, or fire area.
SYS-292.exampleUk: У CS2 explosion може взаємодіяти зі smoke й incendiary fire.

SYS-293.explanationEn: Lethal damage ends current-round control and drops eligible gear.
SYS-293.exampleUk: У CS2 defeated player spectates до нового spawn.
SYS-293.exampleEn: In CS2, a defeated player spectates until the new spawn.

SYS-294.explanationUk: Elimination, timeout, plant, defuse й explosion мають різний precedence.
SYS-294.explanationEn: Elimination, timeout, plant, defuse, and explosion have distinct precedence.
SYS-294.exampleUk: У CS2 planted C4 продовжує round після original clock.

CON-261.labelUk: Buy gate за time, zone і money

CON-261.explanationUk: Item unavailable поза buy window/zone або без funds.

CON-261.exampleEn: In CS2, a late rotation does not allow buying another grenade.

CON-262.explanationUk: Weapon slots, grenade counts, magazine і reserve мають limits.
CON-262.explanationEn: Weapon slots, grenade counts, the magazine, and reserve have limits.
CON-262.exampleUk: У CS2 player не може нести unlimited rifles або utility.
CON-262.exampleEn: In CS2, a player cannot carry unlimited rifles or utility.

ACT-148.explanationUk: Compatible footprint reserves a material-backed build.
ACT-148.explanationEn: A compatible footprint reserves a material-backed build.
ACT-148.exampleUk: A workbench plan waits for materials and workload.
ACT-148.exampleEn: A workbench plan waits for materials and workload.

ACT-161.explanationUk: Player aims a weapon while the world continues.
ACT-161.explanationEn: The player aims a weapon while the world continues.
ACT-161.exampleUk: Shots weaken a wild Pal before capture.
ACT-161.exampleEn: Shots weaken a wild Pal before capture.

ACT-164.explanationUk: One carried quick-slot object becomes ready to use.
ACT-164.explanationEn: One carried quick-slot object becomes ready to use.
ACT-164.exampleUk: Player switches from weapon to Sphere.
ACT-164.exampleEn: The player switches from weapon to Sphere.

ACT-165.explanationUk: One held food item restores hunger.
ACT-165.explanationEn: One held food item restores hunger.
ACT-165.exampleUk: Food sustains a long exploration route.
ACT-165.exampleEn: Food sustains a long exploration route.

SYS-004.labelEn: Select a random outcome
SYS-004.explanationUk: Capture checks sample uncertainty from the current chance.
SYS-004.explanationEn: Capture checks sample uncertainty from the current chance.
SYS-004.exampleUk: The same displayed chance can succeed or fail.
SYS-004.exampleEn: The same displayed chance can succeed or fail.

SYS-045.explanationUk: Party and base Pals path without per-step input.
SYS-045.explanationEn: Party and base Pals path without per-step input.
SYS-045.exampleUk: A worker walks from mine to storage.
SYS-045.exampleEn: A worker walks from mine to storage.

SYS-051.explanationUk: A deployed Pal acquires an eligible nearby target.
SYS-051.explanationEn: A deployed Pal acquires an eligible nearby target.

SYS-186.explanationUk: Eligible tasks compete by assignment and priority.
SYS-186.explanationEn: Eligible tasks compete by assignment and priority.
SYS-186.exampleUk: A fixed mine assignment beats another compatible task.
SYS-186.exampleEn: A fixed mine assignment beats another compatible task.

SYS-196.explanationUk: Transport work moves eligible items to capacity.
SYS-196.explanationEn: Transport work moves eligible items to capacity.
SYS-196.exampleUk: A Pal carries ore into a chest.
SYS-196.exampleEn: A Pal carries ore into a chest.

SYS-197.exampleUk: Higher suitability finishes compatible work faster.
SYS-197.exampleEn: Higher suitability finishes compatible work faster.

SYS-215.explanationUk: Attacks update health, armour and defeat live.
SYS-215.explanationEn: Attacks update health, armour, and defeat live.
SYS-215.exampleUk: Player and active Pal can attack together.
SYS-215.exampleEn: The player and active Pal can attack together.

SYS-222.explanationUk: Contact transfers eligible drops into inventory.
SYS-222.explanationEn: Contact transfers eligible drops into inventory.

SYS-223.explanationUk: Eligible uses reduce durability toward breakage.
SYS-223.explanationEn: Eligible uses reduce durability toward breakage.
SYS-223.exampleUk: Tools and armour need repair or replacement.
SYS-223.exampleEn: Tools and armour need repair or replacement.

SYS-312.explanationUk: Supplied player or Pal work produces the item or structure.
SYS-312.explanationEn: Supplied player or Pal work produces the item or structure.

SYS-313.explanationUk: Terrain, resources and built bases persist in the save.
SYS-313.explanationEn: Terrain, resources, and built bases persist in the save.
SYS-313.exampleUk: A constructed base remains after travel.
SYS-313.exampleEn: A constructed base remains after travel.

SYS-216.explanationUk: Death applies configured loss and returns the avatar in the same world.
SYS-216.explanationEn: Death applies configured loss and returns the avatar in the same world.

CON-062.labelEn: A structure needs a compatible footprint
CON-062.explanationUk: Terrain and overlap can reject placement.
CON-062.explanationEn: Terrain and overlap can reject placement.
CON-062.exampleUk: A workbench cannot overlap another structure.
CON-062.exampleEn: A workbench cannot overlap another structure.

CON-192.labelEn: A worker must reach the job
CON-192.explanationUk: Permission, capability and path gate a task.
CON-192.explanationEn: Permission, capability, and path gate a task.

CON-193.explanationUk: Valid plan completes only after supply and work.
CON-193.explanationEn: A valid plan completes only after supply and work.
CON-193.exampleUk: Missing wood leaves the structure unfinished.
CON-193.exampleEn: Missing wood leaves the structure unfinished.

CON-200.explanationUk: Only compatible items fit available storage.
CON-200.explanationEn: Only compatible items fit available storage.
CON-200.exampleUk: A full chest blocks another haul.
CON-200.exampleEn: A full chest blocks another haul.

CON-210.explanationUk: Typed capacity bounds pickup and carry.
CON-210.explanationEn: Typed capacity bounds pickup and carry.
CON-210.exampleUk: A full inventory rejects another item stack.
CON-210.exampleEn: A full inventory rejects another item stack.

CON-281.explanationUk: Hunger, climate, stamina and durability limit travel.
CON-281.explanationEn: Hunger, climate, stamina, and durability limit travel.
CON-281.exampleEn: A cold region requires compatible protection.

INF-059.explanationUk: Dependencies are visible before unlock or crafting.
INF-059.explanationEn: Dependencies are visible before unlock or crafting.
INF-059.exampleUk: Technology panel shows point cost and tier.
INF-059.exampleEn: The technology panel shows point cost and tier.

INF-073.explanationUk: HUD exposes carried slots and selected item.
INF-073.explanationEn: The HUD exposes carried slots and the selected item.
INF-073.exampleEn: The current Sphere count is visible.

INF-075.explanationUk: Health, hunger, armour and wear are inspectable.
INF-075.explanationEn: Health, hunger, armour, and wear are inspectable.
INF-075.exampleUk: The player can see equipment nearing breakage.
INF-075.exampleEn: The player can see equipment nearing breakage.

INF-124.explanationUk: HUD exposes player resources and companion readiness.
INF-124.explanationEn: The HUD exposes player resources and companion readiness.
INF-124.exampleUk: Active Pal health is visible during battle.
INF-124.exampleEn: Active Pal health is visible during battle.

TIM-003.labelUk: Просувати світ у реальному часі
TIM-003.labelEn: Advance the world in real time
TIM-003.explanationUk: Combat, work, hunger and cooldowns continue during choice.
TIM-003.explanationEn: Combat, work, hunger, and cooldowns continue during choice.
TIM-003.exampleUk: Base workers continue while the player moves nearby.
TIM-003.exampleEn: Base workers continue while the player moves nearby.

ACT-087.labelEn: Apply an item to a fixture
ACT-087.explanationUk: Held key item activates its compatible world fixture.
ACT-087.explanationEn: A held key item activates its compatible world fixture.
ACT-087.exampleUk: Echoing Flute enables the matching raid stone.
ACT-087.exampleEn: The Echoing Flute enables the matching raid stone.

ACT-198.labelEn: Jump and choose a landing region
ACT-198.explanationUk: Момент виходу з літака та керування падінням визначають доступний стартовий район.
ACT-198.explanationEn: Exit timing and aerial steering determine the reachable starting region.
ACT-198.exampleUk: Гравець стрибає пізніше, щоб долетіти до віддалених будинків.
ACT-198.exampleEn: The player exits later to reach a distant compound.

ACT-199.explanationUk: Предмет із землі переходить у сумісний стек або слот спорядження.
ACT-199.explanationEn: A ground item transfers into a compatible stack or equipment slot.
ACT-199.exampleEn: A sight is fitted to a compatible rifle.

ACT-201.explanationUk: Місце водія дає прямий контроль швидкості й напрямку, інші місця — перевезення.
ACT-201.explanationEn: The driver seat grants direct speed and steering control while other seats carry riders.
ACT-201.exampleUk: Автомобіль скорочує шлях до наступного кола.
ACT-201.exampleEn: A car shortens the route to the next circle.

SYS-316.explanationUk: Система наповнює матч учасниками та визначає маршрут літака, лут і транспорт.
SYS-316.explanationEn: The system fills the roster and samples the aircraft route, loot, and vehicles.
SYS-316.exampleUk: Той самий Erangel починається з іншої лінії польоту й розкладки предметів.
SYS-316.exampleEn: The same Erangel begins with a different flight line and item layout.

SYS-317.explanationUk: Гравітація, керування, купол і зіткнення ведуть учасника до посадки.
SYS-317.explanationEn: Gravity, steering, canopy deployment, and collision carry the participant to landing.
SYS-317.exampleUk: Круте падіння дає швидшу, але ближчу посадку.
SYS-317.exampleEn: A steep dive yields a faster but nearer landing.

SYS-321.explanationUk: Після попередження Blue Zone рухається до нового кола й дедалі сильніше шкодить за безперервне перебування назовні.
SYS-321.explanationEn: After warning, the Blue Zone closes on a new circle and increasingly damages continuous exposure.
SYS-321.exampleUk: Затримка за межею кола робить наступні тики небезпечнішими.
SYS-321.exampleEn: Lingering outside the circle makes later damage ticks harsher.

SYS-325.explanationUk: Смертельна поразка створює ящик, зменшує число живих і оголошує останнього переможцем.
SYS-325.explanationEn: Lethal defeat creates a crate, reduces the alive count, and declares the final survivor.
SYS-325.exampleUk: Останнє усунення запускає Winner Winner Chicken Dinner.
SYS-325.exampleEn: The final elimination triggers Winner Winner Chicken Dinner.

CON-283.explanationUk: Досягти можна лише місця в межах падіння та планерування від обраної точки виходу.
CON-283.explanationEn: Only regions within fall and glide range of the chosen exit are reachable.
CON-283.exampleUk: Далекий острів може бути недосяжним із поточної лінії.
CON-283.exampleEn: A distant island may be unreachable from the current line.

CON-284.labelEn: Capacity and slots bound the loadout
CON-284.explanationUk: Вага предмета має поміститися, а його клас — відповідати вільному слоту.
CON-284.explanationEn: An item's bulk must fit and its class must match an available slot.
CON-284.exampleUk: Переповнений наплічник не приймає весь стек набоїв.
CON-284.exampleEn: A full backpack cannot accept the whole ammunition stack.

CON-288.labelUk: Транспорт потребує місця, пального й проїзду
CON-288.labelEn: Vehicles need a seat, fuel, and a viable route
CON-288.explanationUk: Керування залежить від доступного місця й справності, а геометрія та швидкість роблять рух ризикованим.
CON-288.explanationEn: Operation depends on an accessible viable seat, while geometry and speed make travel risky.
CON-288.exampleUk: Пробите колесо погіршує керованість, а швидкий вихід травмує.
CON-288.exampleEn: A destroyed tyre impairs handling, and a fast exit injures.

CON-289.explanationUk: Кожна фаза змушує вчасно перейти в меншу область або втрачати здоров’я.
CON-289.explanationEn: Each phase forces timely movement into a smaller region or health is lost.
CON-289.exampleUk: Далекий наступний круг вимагає рушити раніше.
CON-289.exampleEn: A distant next circle requires leaving earlier.

CON-290.explanationUk: Після смертельної поразки учасник уже не повертається до цього матчу.
CON-290.explanationEn: After lethal defeat, the participant cannot return to that match.
CON-290.exampleUk: Немає напарника, Recall або нового раунду.
CON-290.exampleEn: There is no teammate, Recall, or next round.

INF-115.explanationUk: Зір і звук відкривають лише локальні ознаки позицій та дій суперників.
INF-115.explanationEn: Sight and sound expose only local evidence of opponent positions and actions.
INF-115.exampleUk: Постріли чути, але стрільця не обов’язково видно.
INF-115.exampleEn: Gunfire is audible even when the shooter is not visible.

INF-127.labelEn: See the map, zones, and timers
INF-127.explanationUk: Карта показує поточну позицію, межі небезпеки та час наступної фази, але не майбутній центр.
INF-127.explanationEn: The map shows current position, hazard boundaries, and phase timing but not a future centre.
INF-127.exampleUk: Біле коло й таймер підказують наступний маршрут.
INF-127.exampleEn: The white circle and timer inform the next route.

INF-128.explanationUk: Назви, кількість, слоти й залишок місткості видимі до перенесення предмета.
INF-128.explanationEn: Identity, quantity, slots, and remaining capacity are visible before transfer.
INF-128.exampleUk: Інвентар показує, чи підійде магазин до зброї.
INF-128.exampleEn: The inventory shows whether a magazine fits the weapon.

INF-129.explanationUk: Лічильник живих і стрічка повідомляють, як скорочується поле суперників.
INF-129.explanationEn: The alive counter and feed reveal how the opposing field is shrinking.
INF-129.exampleEn: The ALIVE count falls after a fight.

OBJ-074.explanationUk: Перемагає єдиний живий учасник завершеного Solo-матчу.
OBJ-074.explanationEn: The sole living participant at the end of the Solo match wins.
OBJ-074.exampleUk: Вижити довше за всіх інших дає Chicken Dinner.
OBJ-074.exampleEn: Outlasting every other participant earns the Chicken Dinner.

ACT-008.labelEn: Move through the world
ACT-008.explanationUk: Пряме керування веде персонажа по безперервній місцевості.
ACT-008.explanationEn: Direct input moves the avatar through continuous terrain.
ACT-008.exampleUk: Гравець біжить між укриттями.
ACT-008.exampleEn: The player runs between cover.

ACT-161.explanationUk: Гравець прицілюється й застосовує зброю в реальному часі.
ACT-161.explanationEn: The player aims and uses a weapon in real time.
ACT-161.exampleEn: A burst is aimed at a visible target.

ACT-164.explanationUk: Один предмет або вид зброї стає готовим до використання.
ACT-164.explanationEn: One item or weapon becomes ready for use.
ACT-164.exampleUk: Гравець перемикається з гвинтівки на гранату.
ACT-164.exampleEn: The player switches from a rifle to a grenade.

ACT-183.explanationUk: Предмет можна залишити у світі, щоб його підібрав інший учасник.
ACT-183.explanationEn: An item can be left in the world for another participant to collect.
ACT-183.exampleEn: Spare ammunition is dropped on the ground.

ACT-184.explanationUk: Сумісні запасні набої переходять у зброю після живої дії.
ACT-184.explanationEn: Compatible reserve ammunition enters the weapon through a live action.
ACT-184.exampleUk: Порожній магазин замінюється перед наступним боєм.
ACT-184.exampleEn: An empty magazine is replaced before the next fight.

ACT-200.explanationUk: Гравець запускає переривний таймер медичного або стимулювального предмета.
ACT-200.explanationEn: The player starts an interruptible medical or boost-item timer.
ACT-200.exampleUk: Аптечка спрацьовує лише після завершення застосування.
ACT-200.exampleEn: A First Aid Kit works only after its use completes.

ACT-202.explanationUk: Поза змінює видиму частину тіла, швидкість і поводження зброї.
ACT-202.explanationEn: Posture changes body exposure, movement, and weapon handling.
ACT-202.exampleUk: Присідання ховає більшу частину тіла за стіною.
ACT-202.exampleEn: Crouching hides more of the body behind a wall.

SYS-208.explanationUk: Траєкторія, матеріал, дальність і зона влучання визначають наслідок пострілу.
SYS-208.explanationEn: Trajectory, material, range, and hit region determine a shot's result.
SYS-208.exampleUk: Стіна може зупинити або послабити кулю.
SYS-208.exampleEn: A wall can stop or weaken a bullet.

SYS-215.explanationUk: Рух, постріли, ушкодження й смерть оновлюються без паузи між ходами.
SYS-215.explanationEn: Movement, shots, damage, and death update without turn pauses.
SYS-215.exampleUk: Суперник може рухатися, поки гравець лікується.
SYS-215.exampleEn: An opponent can move while the player heals.

SYS-292.explanationUk: Кидок, запал і тип боєприпасу створюють вибух, дим, вогонь або засліплення.
SYS-292.explanationEn: Throw, fuse, and munition type create blast, smoke, fire, or flash effects.
SYS-292.exampleUk: Дим перекриває лінію огляду під час переходу.
SYS-292.exampleEn: Smoke blocks sight during a crossing.

SYS-318.explanationUk: Сумісні модулі змінюють зброю, а шолом і жилет захищають свої зони до зношення.
SYS-318.explanationEn: Compatible attachments modify weapons, while helmet and vest protect their regions until worn out.
SYS-318.exampleUk: Влучання в шолом зменшує його міцність.
SYS-318.exampleEn: A helmet hit reduces its durability.

SYS-319.explanationUk: Неперерване застосування витрачає предмет і відновлює здоров’я одразу або з часом.
SYS-319.explanationEn: Uninterrupted use consumes the item and restores health immediately or over time.
SYS-319.exampleUk: Енергетик наповнює запас бусту, що поступово спадає.
SYS-319.exampleEn: An Energy Drink adds boost that decays over time.

SYS-320.explanationUk: Покриття, пальне, колеса, зіткнення й обстріл впливають на машину та пасажирів.
SYS-320.explanationEn: Surface, fuel, tyres, collisions, and gunfire affect the vehicle and occupants.
SYS-320.exampleUk: Удар на великій швидкості травмує пасажира.
SYS-320.exampleEn: A high-speed collision injures an occupant.

SYS-322.explanationUk: Літак скидає випадкове рідкісне спорядження, а червоний дим відкриває його позицію всім.
SYS-322.explanationEn: An aircraft drops sampled high-tier gear, and red smoke exposes its position to everyone.
SYS-322.exampleUk: Дим приваблює кількох суперників до ящика.
SYS-322.exampleEn: The smoke draws several opponents to the crate.

CON-262.labelEn: Actions require a valid live state
CON-262.explanationUk: Смерть, перезарядження чи інша зайнятість блокують несумісну дію.
CON-262.explanationEn: Death, reloading, or another busy state blocks an incompatible action.
CON-262.exampleUk: Під час певної анімації не можна одразу стріляти.
CON-262.exampleEn: The player cannot fire immediately during an incompatible animation.

CON-285.explanationUk: Набої, магазин, модуль, режим і поза мають дозволяти постріл або зміну.
CON-285.explanationEn: Ammunition, magazine, attachment, mode, and posture must permit the operation.
CON-285.exampleUk: Неправильний калібр не заряджається в гвинтівку.
CON-285.exampleEn: The wrong ammunition type cannot load into a rifle.

CON-286.labelEn: Healing requires an uninterrupted legal cast
CON-286.explanationUk: Стан здоров’я має дозволяти предмет, а скасування до кінця не дає ефекту.
CON-286.explanationEn: Health state must permit the item, and cancellation before completion gives no effect.
CON-286.exampleEn: A sudden movement cancels the First Aid Kit.

CON-287.labelEn: Armour protects only its covered region
CON-287.explanationUk: Зменшення шкоди діє для відповідної частини тіла, доки спорядження не зламане.
CON-287.explanationEn: Damage reduction applies to the matching body region while the equipment remains durable.
CON-287.exampleEn: A vest does not protect the head.

INF-073.explanationUk: HUD показує вибрану зброю, боєзапас і швидкі предмети.
INF-073.explanationEn: The HUD shows the selected weapon, ammunition, and quick items.
INF-073.exampleUk: Лічильник показує набої в магазині й запасі.
INF-073.exampleEn: The counter shows loaded and reserve rounds.

INF-075.explanationUk: Гравець може оцінити здоров’я, буст і стан захисту.
INF-075.explanationEn: The player can inspect health, boost, and protective equipment condition.
INF-075.exampleEn: A damaged helmet is visible in the inventory.

TIM-003.labelUk: Продовжувати матч у реальному часі
TIM-003.labelEn: Advance the match in real time
TIM-003.explanationUk: Суперники, зони, таймери й ефекти рухаються, поки гравець приймає рішення.
TIM-003.explanationEn: Opponents, zones, timers, and effects continue while the player decides.
TIM-003.exampleUk: Blue Zone стискається під час пошуку луту.
TIM-003.exampleEn: The Blue Zone closes while the player searches for loot.

ACT-186.explanationUk: Гравець готує та спрямовує переносний боєприпас по дузі.
ACT-186.explanationEn: The player primes and directs a carried munition along an arc.
ACT-186.exampleEn: A smoke grenade covers an open crossing.

ACT-203.explanationUk: Дозволений інструмент або вибух прибирає частину ґрунту.
ACT-203.explanationEn: An eligible tool or explosion removes part of the ground.
ACT-203.exampleUk: Кирка створює неглибоке заглиблення на Erangel.
ACT-203.exampleEn: A pickaxe creates a shallow depression on Erangel.

SYS-323.labelEn: Warn and bombard a Red Zone
SYS-323.explanationUk: Випадкова позначена область після затримки отримує серію вибухів.
SYS-323.explanationEn: A randomly marked region receives a series of explosions after a warning.
SYS-323.exampleEn: A building offers a chance to shelter from the bombardment.

SYS-324.explanationUk: Зміна об’єму землі оновлює зіткнення й лишається до кінця матчу.
SYS-324.explanationEn: Removing ground volume updates collision and remains for the match.
SYS-324.exampleUk: Вибух залишає придатну до укриття виїмку.
SYS-324.exampleEn: An explosion leaves a depression usable as cover.

CON-291.labelUk: Копати можна не всюди й не чим завгодно
CON-291.labelEn: Excavation needs valid ground and a source
CON-291.explanationUk: Лише підтримувана поверхня, глибина та джерело пошкодження дозволяють деформацію.
CON-291.explanationEn: Only supported surface, depth, and damage source permit deformation.
CON-291.exampleUk: Кам’яна конструкція не стає ямою від кирки.
CON-291.exampleEn: A stone structure does not become a pit from a pickaxe.

ACT-204.explanationUk: У scoped Rust цей ген визначає механічну дію або перевірку «Змінити connected building block».
ACT-204.explanationEn: In scoped Rust, this gene defines the mechanical action or check “Change a connected building block”.
ACT-204.exampleUk: Rust progression trace демонструє: змінити connected building block.
ACT-204.exampleEn: The Rust progression trace demonstrates: change a connected building block.

ACT-205.explanationUk: У scoped Rust цей ген визначає механічну дію або перевірку «Налаштувати fixture authority».
ACT-205.explanationEn: In scoped Rust, this gene defines the mechanical action or check “Configure fixture authority”.
ACT-205.exampleUk: Rust progression trace демонструє: налаштувати fixture authority.
ACT-205.exampleEn: The Rust progression trace demonstrates: configure fixture authority.

ACT-207.explanationUk: У scoped Rust цей ген визначає механічну дію або перевірку «Вивчити item recipe».
ACT-207.explanationEn: In scoped Rust, this gene defines the mechanical action or check “Learn an item recipe”.
ACT-207.exampleUk: Rust progression trace демонструє: вивчити item recipe.
ACT-207.exampleEn: The Rust progression trace demonstrates: learn an item recipe.

ACT-208.explanationUk: У scoped Rust цей ген визначає механічну дію або перевірку «Призначити respawn fixture».

ACT-210.explanationUk: Occupation і point-balanced traits задають starting skills та persistent modifiers.

ACT-210.exampleUk: Player компенсує positive trait negative trait, щоб confirm став legal.
ACT-210.exampleEn: The player offsets a positive trait with a negative one so confirmation becomes legal.

ACT-211.explanationUk: Medical item застосовується до обраної body region під час vulnerable action.
ACT-211.explanationEn: A medical item is applied to a selected body region during a vulnerable timed action.
ACT-211.exampleUk: Bandage на injured forearm зупиняє bleeding після completion.
ACT-211.exampleEn: A bandage on an injured forearm stops bleeding after completion.

ACT-212.labelEn: Reinforce an opening by one layer
ACT-212.explanationUk: Tools і carried material додають або legal знімають один barricade layer.
ACT-212.explanationEn: Tools and carried material add, or legally remove, one barricade layer.
ACT-212.exampleUk: Hammer, nails і plank додають перший layer до window.
ACT-212.exampleEn: A hammer, nails, and plank add the first layer to a window.

ACT-213.explanationUk: Seed, water або treatment змінює стан однієї world crop.
ACT-213.explanationEn: Seed, water, or treatment changes one persistent world crop.
ACT-213.exampleUk: Season-valid seed висівається і потім поливається.
ACT-213.exampleEn: A season-valid seed is sown and later watered.

ACT-214.explanationUk: Sleep відновлює fatigue, поки той самий world просувається.
ACT-214.explanationEn: Sleep restores fatigue while the same vulnerable world advances.
ACT-214.exampleUk: Survivor sleeps у secured bedroom і wakes після elapsed hours.
ACT-214.exampleEn: The survivor sleeps in a secured bedroom and wakes after elapsed hours.

SYS-338.explanationUk: Hidden bodily values переходять graded thresholds і модифікують actions.
SYS-338.explanationEn: Hidden bodily values cross graded thresholds and modify actions.
SYS-338.exampleUk: Exertion переходить у вищий moodle і послаблює combat.
SYS-338.exampleEn: Exertion reaches a higher moodle and weakens combat.

SYS-339.labelUk: Повести zombies на sight і sound
SYS-339.labelEn: Route zombies from sight and sound
SYS-339.explanationUk: Perceived cue дає local target і path, але не omniscient player location.
SYS-339.explanationEn: A perceived cue provides a local target and route, not omniscient player location.
SYS-339.exampleUk: Broken window приваблює nearby zombies до sound origin.
SYS-339.exampleEn: A broken window draws nearby zombies toward the sound origin.

SYS-341.explanationUk: Established hidden infection посилює sickness до fatal outcome і zombie return.
SYS-341.explanationEn: Established hidden infection escalates sickness to a fatal outcome and zombie return.
SYS-341.exampleUk: Cared-for bite лишається bandaged, але symptoms ведуть до death.
SYS-341.exampleEn: A cared-for bite remains bandaged, but symptoms still lead to death.

SYS-343.explanationUk: Barricades міняють geometry і втрачають health від attacks.
SYS-343.explanationEn: Barricades change geometry and lose health under attacks.
SYS-343.exampleUk: Група zombies поступово вибиває planks з window.
SYS-343.exampleEn: A group of zombies gradually breaks planks from a window.

SYS-344.explanationUk: Time міняє weather, utilities, food freshness і crop growth.
SYS-344.explanationEn: Time changes weather, utilities, food freshness, and crop growth.
SYS-344.exampleUk: Power ends, fridge зупиняється і perishable food старіє швидше.
SYS-344.exampleEn: Power ends, the fridge stops, and perishable food ages faster.

SYS-345.explanationUk: Lethal state permanently removes control цього survivor без same-life return.
SYS-345.explanationEn: Lethal state permanently removes control of this survivor with no same-life return.
SYS-345.exampleUk: New character у тому самому save не відновлює dead identity.
SYS-345.exampleEn: A new character in the same save does not restore the dead identity.

CON-305.labelUk: Бути perceived і reachable для pursuit
CON-305.labelEn: Be perceived and reachable for pursuit
CON-305.explanationUk: Zombie потребує cue/memory і route through current openings або destructible barriers.
CON-305.explanationEn: A zombie needs a cue or memory and a route through openings or destructible barriers.
CON-305.exampleUk: Closed curtained window прибирає sight cue, але alarm лишає sound cue.
CON-305.exampleEn: A curtained window removes the sight cue, but an alarm still provides sound.

CON-308.labelUk: Не мати cure для established Knox state
CON-308.labelEn: Have no cure for established Knox state
CON-308.explanationUk: Ordinary treatment не повертає concealed infected survivor в uninfected state.
CON-308.explanationEn: Ordinary treatment cannot return a concealed infected survivor to an uninfected state.
CON-308.exampleUk: Disinfectant допомагає wound, але не скасовує Knox Infection.
CON-308.exampleEn: Disinfectant helps the wound but does not cancel Knox Infection.

CON-309.explanationUk: Opening side, layer capacity, tools, fasteners і material мають бути compatible.
CON-309.explanationEn: Opening side, layer capacity, tools, fasteners, and material must be compatible.
CON-309.exampleUk: Plank без nails і hammer не стає window barricade.
CON-309.exampleEn: A plank without nails and a hammer does not become a window barricade.

CON-311.labelEn: Grow only a viable seasonal crop
CON-311.explanationUk: Species потребує proper month, water, health і enough calendar time.
CON-311.explanationEn: A species needs the proper month, water, health, and enough calendar time.
CON-311.exampleUk: Crop у doomed planting month не дає ordinary harvest від самого waiting.
CON-311.exampleEn: A crop planted in a doomed month does not gain an ordinary harvest merely by waiting.
